cards.definition: pipeline — sequência automatizada de build e deploy
cards.example_sentence: The CI/CD pipeline failed because of a unit test error.

cards.definition: container — ambiente isolado e portátil para executar aplicações
cards.example_sentence: Each service runs in its own Docker container.

cards.definition: Kubernetes — plataforma de orquestração de containers
cards.example_sentence: We use Kubernetes to manage container deployments in production.

cards.definition: rollback — reversão para uma versão anterior do sistema
cards.example_sentence: We triggered a rollback after the deploy caused a production error.
The vulnerability was found during the penetration test.

cards.definition: exploit — código que aproveita uma vulnerabilidade
cards.example_sentence: The attacker used a SQL injection exploit to gain access.

cards.definition: OAuth — protocolo de autorização de acesso
cards.example_sentence: All API endpoints must be authenticated using OAuth 2.0.
We chose a microservices architecture for independent scaling.

cards.definition: API gateway — ponto central de entrada para APIs
cards.example_sentence: The API gateway handles authentication, rate limiting, and routing.
